limitations: Actual iPhone TMAP app launch and route initiation cannot be tested in this isolated environment.
Coordinate lookup uses the existing OpenStreetMap/Nominatim call in the app; correctness of entrance-level location must be checked on device.
On coordinate lookup failure, no route URI/homepage is opened; the user is told to verify place/address in Naver Maps.
